consolidated_schema.optimization_notes: Consolidated similar fields like Pipeline Status and Completion Status into Processing Status. Combined Kafka Topic and Number of Partitions. Removed Sprint Number as it was deemed less valuable. Prioritized key metadata and processing information.
consolidated_schema.extraction_prompt: Extract key information related to document processing, including document identifiers, workflow details, processing status, content types, and technologies used. Focus on capturing specific values for each field as described.
